h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amritsar

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amritsar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Amritsar

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Amritsar to colony parks, schools, colleges, gurdwara and trust grounds, housing societies and municipal gardens. We build our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1,380 km away, and send them to Punjab by road. Our installation team or a north India dealer fixes them on site.

Amritsar's year has two hard seasons for outdoor equipment. Summers are very hot and dusty, and winters bring cold and thick fog. Neighbourhood parks here are busy early, with walkers, groups doing yoga and older men and women who meet every day. An open gym fits into that routine if it sits beside the walking path and does not take the open lawn people use for group exercise. Body-weight machines suit mixed age groups, and galvanised frames with roto-moulded parts handle the swing between heat and damp winter mornings.

facts.value: About 1,380 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can an RWA in Amritsar order a small open gym?
items.a: Yes. Many start with three or four machines. Send us the park size and photos, and we will send a layout drawing that keeps the lawn free for group exercise.

items.q: Do you deliver outdoor gym equipment to Punjab?
items.a: Yes. Everything is made at our Vasai factory and sent by road. Installation is by our team or a dealer in north India, grouted or self-standing to suit the ground.

items.q: How do the machines cope with Amritsar's fog and cold?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist moisture. Wipe the machines down after foggy spells and keep moving parts clean, as described in the maintenance steps we share.
